fusions.name: Journey's End
fusions.desc: A bite at the end of a long run that deals 30 damage and ignores the target's armour. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 36%.

fusions.name: Heel Nip
fusions.desc: A nip at the heel that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Each hit has a 20% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Trot
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 40% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Wears the Road Down
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
